text_block_list.text: It was on the way back from an outing—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, Curren is working hard with 
Big Brother in the Twinkle Series."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, Curren is working hard with 
Big Sister in the Twinkle Series."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Still, I feel like there's still something 
missing.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
—Curren only just enrolled, so she needs 
to make friends with all sorts of people☆

...It was right after walking Curren Chan, 
who was smiling like that, back to the 
dorms.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah----!!!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha, my apologies. Don't worry, it's 
just the usual for me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Come now, Sweep. We're right at the 
entrance. Besides, it's time for everyone 
to head back to the dorms. You shouldâ

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Nooooo waaaay!! I'm gonna bathe in the 
moonlight right here-!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's true this time! I saw it in a book! 
Moonlight turns into magical power!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmmmm... So you really, absolutely refuse 
to move, huh.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately though, as dorm head, I 
cannot accept that demand.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now then, little tomboy witch. Shall we 
head back to the dorm together?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaah------!!!!
choice_data_list: ...Looks like it's going to take a while.
...Looks like it's going to take a while.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha... but it's bad if we leave it like 
this, right? ...Hmm. Let's see here.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Fuji-san.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"If Sweep-chan isn't coming back right 
away, does that mean there's an extra 
'Jiggly Pudding' for dinner?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, pudding?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Can Curren eat it instead? Sweet, 
deliciouuus, jiggly pudding♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...*slurp*

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, tonight Curren gets t-w-o puddings♪ 
T-w—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: No, no, no! Don't take my pudding--!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Heheheh. Curren, you really are 
amusing.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Moving people with such vivid words... 
...Could it be that you're a witch too?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm not a witch~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's just that I'm selfish in the same way 
as Sweep-chan... so I understood how she 
felt. Teehee☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's just that I'm selfish in the same way 
as Sweep-chan... so I understood how she 
felt. Teehee☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't that right? Because to Curren, 
more than anything else—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I just couldn't help wanting to get back 
quickly before you started worrying about 
me, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I just really wanted to get home quickly 
before Big Sister started worrying, you 
see.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Curren's just being selfish, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's quite an adorable little 
whim.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, is that so? If you think it's cute, 
then I'm happy~

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, then I'm gonna be just a little more 
selfish! Right, Fuji-san?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hm? What is it, Curren?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"If you ever need anything, rely on 
Curren. As long as you're okay with a 
selfish Curren, that is♪"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, my, my... I would gladly take you up 
on that offer.

—From that day on, Fuji Kiseki and Curren 
Chan were seen talking to each other much 
more often...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh. Big bro, isn't that where you're 
supposed to deny it~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh. Big sis, isn't that where you're 
supposed to deny it~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
“So, Big Brother... do you still love 
Curren, even when she's being selfish~?”
choice_data_list: I do think you're cute, you know.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
“So, Big Sister... do you still love 
Curren, even when she's being selfish~?”
choice_data_list: I do think you're cute, you know.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yay~! Someone called me cute again today~♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha. What perfect chemistry in your 
back-and-forth. A spoiled princess and her 
loyal knight, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, in that case, Fuji-san, please play 
the role of the Minister!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If you ever need any help, please contact 
me right away♪ Let's help each other out, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, well. Looks like I've been 
incorporated into the act as well...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Still, the princess seems quite 
dependable. Perhaps I'll ask for her help 
sometime?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'd love to♪

—From that day on, Fuji Kiseki and Curren 
Chan were seen talking to each other much 
more often...
